scenes.title: Agents that talk to each other

sentences.text: A two A, Agent to Agent, is a standard that lets agents built with different frameworks work together, like two people who speak different languages but agree on a common protocol.
It supports multiple turns and rich metadata.
Think of it as a common language between agents.
You go to Agents, Add agent, A two A agent, and you paste the address of the endpoint, not the address of the agent card.
If there is a valid agent card, the name and description fill in by themselves; if not, write a good description.
Pay close attention to which one you paste.
Authentication can be none, A P I key in the header or query, or O Auth two point zero.
The message carries a context I D, message identifiers, the language, and the full conversation history in the metadata.
All of that travels inside the metadata of the message.
For development, expose your local agent with Dev Tunnels and make the port public.
Because A two A uses the custom connectors infrastructure, it can reach agents that are on-premises or in virtual networks.
This is very useful while you are still building and testing your agent.
